evidence.claim: Santander UK participated in FCA's Digital Regulatory Reporting (DRR) Pilot Phase 1
evidence.excerpt: Santander UK was among the participating firms in Phase 1 of the FCA's Digital Regulatory Reporting pilot, which explored machine-executable regulatory reporting using standardized data models.

evidence.claim: Santander UK continued participation in FCA DRR Pilot Phase 2
evidence.excerpt: Phase 2 of the pilot expanded on Phase 1 learnings with Santander UK continuing as a participating firm in exploring automated regulatory reporting solutions.
